contract: RecordHeader is the one typed column-naming policy: Source, None, Rows(n), Infer. Scalar intake resolves Booleans, null, positive integer rows, and the named strings once; malformed values fail at $.header.

CSV stores its one-header Boolean, accepts Source, None and Rows(1), and refuses other row counts and Infer atomically. Excel retains physical multirow headers, conservative inferred reads, and authoritative named-table columns.

ExcelOptions::require_valid checks the combined sheet, range, table and header intent before declared-schema shortcuts or I/O. RecordOptions selection/table/range setters validate the prospective state and restore the previous options on refusal; typed selection errors name their member.

IORecordOptions::result_field binds filter and select in the reader's order, including filters over a selected alias. IOMedia and container schema reads return the projected result of a declared source without opening it. Encoding wrappers apply that result after obtaining their own source schema; caches retain the unprojected source.
